blocks.text: Iramoo Native Plant Nursery propagates indigenous species from locally collected seed — supplying restoration projects, schools, gardens and councils across Melbourne's west.
Tubestock and advanced plants of grasses, lilies, daisies, orchids and shrubs native to the basalt plains. All seed is provenance-tracked from the Iramoo grassland and surrounding remnants.

Wednesdays 10am – 2pm
First Saturday of the month 9am – 12pm
Group visits by appointment
